descriptor.scene: THE REALISATION. Inside the GLOWING ORANGE SCREEN, a book lies open, and out of its pages the SAME WOMAN, Naomi, has risen and now stands CLEAR OF THE PAGES at her own level, calm and whole, while below her the pages of the book fan out beneath her feet like ground she is standing above. She is plainly not part of any single page. Faint glowing threads connect her down to several of the pages at once, showing she walks through many of them. Marcus is at the desk in the warm room, still, watching. Naomi appears only inside the screen. THE LAPTOP IS WHOLLY HOLOGRAPHIC AND THIS IS THE THING TO GET RIGHT: the ENTIRE machine, its lid AND its screen frame AND its keyboard AND its base AND its hinge AND its edges, is ONE single translucent luminous object made of light, glowing all the way through, so you can SEE THROUGH the whole thing to the desk and the room behind it. NO PART of it is solid, opaque, dark, grey, brown, black, metal or plastic. It has NO SOLID BASE and NO SOLID LID. It is NOT an ordinary laptop with a bright screen, and it is NOT a floating screen with no body: the whole clamshell is present and the whole clamshell is made of glowing light. It casts warm light onto the desk rather than shadow.
